tweet.text: We’ve completed 100K+ runs using Vivaria for our autonomy and AI R&D evals. By open sourcing Vivaria, we want to help others to replicate our research and study autonomous capabilities. This is just the beginning – we have many improvements planned, and we welcome contributions.
